text: Bitcoin's 1.6% decline outpaces Ethereum's 0.7% drop, signaling mild weakness in the largest asset while altcoins struggle more broadly, yet the Fear & Greed index remains in greed territory despite a recent pullback. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 58.5% with $497B in daily volume suggests the market is processing losses without panic or capitulation. The recent 18-point greed decline hints at some caution creeping in, but positioning remains constructively weighted rather than defensive.
